# signet-protocol (Rust)

> Native Rust apps that verify Signet identity events on Nostr have to
> reimplement the NIP-01 canonical event id and the kind-21236 auth event
> shape from scratch, and drift from the TypeScript reference. signet-protocol
> is the Rust counterpart of the `signet-protocol` npm package: same wire
> format, cross-impl test vectors, one source of truth.

For engine and appliance authors who need Signet verification outside
JavaScript: voxel games, embedded signing hardware, custom Nostr relays,
native multiplayer servers. An event signed by the TypeScript
`signet-protocol` package verifies here and vice versa.

## Getting Started

Not yet published to crates.io; depend on the repository:

```toml
[dependencies]
signet-protocol = { git = "https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-protocol-rs" }
```

```rust
use signet_protocol::{canonical_id, AUTH_EVENT_KIND};

let pubkey = [0xbbu8; 32];
let tags = vec![
    vec!["challenge".to_string(), "a".repeat(64)],
    vec!["origin".to_string(), "https://localhost:8094".to_string()],
];
let id = canonical_id(&pubkey, 1_700_000_000, AUTH_EVENT_KIND, &tags, "");
```

## Key Concepts

- **Canonical event id**: the NIP-01 serialisation (compact JSON, lower-case
  hex pubkey) hashed with SHA-256; the basis every verifier compares against
  an event's `.id` field.
- **Auth events (kind 21236)**: `Sign in with Signet` events, carrying a
  `challenge` and `origin` tag pair that a server must check.
- **Credentials (kind 31000)**: verifiable attestations (display-name,
  age-scope, professional) sharing one kind, differentiated by a `type` tag.
- **Cross-impl vectors**: the same test vectors run against the TypeScript
  package, so the two implementations cannot silently diverge.

## API Surface

- `canonical_id(pubkey, created_at, kind, tags, content) -> [u8; 32]`: the
  NIP-01 canonical event id.
- `AUTH_EVENT_KIND`: `u32` constant, `21236`.
- `CREDENTIAL_KIND`: `u32` constant, `31000`.
- `SignetAuthEvent`: typed kind-21236 event struct (`pubkey`, `created_at`,
  `kind`, `tags`, `content`, `id`, `sig`, `from_np`).
- `SignetCredential`: typed kind-31000 credential struct (`pubkey`,
  `created_at`, `kind`, `tags`, `content`, `id`, `sig`).

Schnorr verification, full auth-event verification, credential verification
and the server-side challenge nonce table are planned; not yet shipped.

  crate.
- [Signet protocol](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet): the protocol this
  crate implements.

  the TypeScript counterpart with the identical wire format.
